note: The new site-level rule strips the trailing slash that Django's APPEND_SLASH adds back, so /api/health/ redirects in a loop; no runbook section covers redirect loops.

cause.title: feat: serve app routes without a trailing slash
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/sites/videoflix.caddy b/sites/videoflix.caddy
@@ -4,6 +4,11 @@ videoflix.philipp-klinger.com {
 	import security_headers
 	encode zstd gzip
 
+	# One URL per page: /browse/ and /browse are the same route of the app,
+	# so the trailing slash is dropped before routing
+	@trailing path_regexp ^(.+)/$
+	uri @trailing strip_suffix /
+
 	# Everything Django serves: API (incl. HLS streams), admin, its static files and API docs
 	@backend path /api/* /admin/* /static/* /swagger/* /redoc/*
 	handle @backend {
